tagline: 宾得胶片单反相机，1987 年发布
description: 宾得于1987年推出的胶片单反相机。配备SMC Pentax 35-70mm zoom (with macro), max. aperture f/3.5.。快门速度B (up to 7 hours!) to 1/2000s. Flash sync at 1/100s.。AF single, AF servo and Manual. Autofocus in approx 0.3s. Minimum distance 0.7m. Spotbeam for low light to 4m.。

specs.曝光测光: Programmed AE, aperture priority, shutter priority, metered manual. Metering range EV1-EV20 at ISO 100 with 50mm f/1.4 lens. Exposure compensation EV-4 to EV+4 in half steps.
specs.快门速度: B (up to 7 hours!) to 1/2000s. Flash sync at 1/100s.
specs.卡口: Pentax K-AF. (Can also accept all K-mount manual lenses, and M42 with an adaptor.)
specs.镜头: SMC Pentax 35-70mm zoom (with macro), max. aperture f/3.5.
specs.对焦: AF single, AF servo and Manual. Autofocus in approx 0.3s. Minimum distance 0.7m. Spotbeam for low light to 4m.
specs.取景器: Pentaprism with diopter adjustment. 92% field of view. Features LED for focus, exposure, shutter speed, flash readiness.
specs.英文简介: The Pentax SFX (SF-1 in US), dating from 1987, was the world's first autofocus 35mm film SLR with built-in TTL auto flash.
